title: Agent statement validation
responsibility: Validates and normalizes the short facts an owner supplies about an agent before those facts are stored.

inputs.name: agentStatement.input
inputs.description: AgentInput contains optional CLI strings supplied when recording an agent statement; the object itself is required. A supplied id must begin with an ASCII letter or digit and contain at most 64 ASCII letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; text fields are trimmed, blank text becomes undefined, and remaining text rejects characters below space or DEL and is limited to label 120, provider/model/loop 80, and task/outcome 200 characters; units accepts at most 40 distinct comma-separated ids of 1–120 lowercase letters, digits, dots or dashes; pid and ttl must convert to whole numbers from 1–2147483647 and 1–86400, respectively.

outputs.name: agentStatement
outputs.description: AgentStatement is the normalized result returned for the supplied agent facts, with optional identity and text fields, optional unit ids, a numeric pid or null, and ttlSeconds in seconds. Text is trimmed and limited to the same per-field lengths as the input, blank text is omitted, units are sorted and deduplicated, pid is null when omitted and otherwise ranges from 1 to 2147483647, and ttlSeconds defaults to 900 or ranges from 1 to 86400.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised through the imported fail helper when a supplied id, text field, unit list, pid or ttl fails validation; each failure message identifies the offending option and states its allowed shape or range.
